entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! This is absolutely unacceptable. I bought these expensive cycling shoes from you, and they're complete garbage! I demand to speak to a manager right now!
I understand you're frustrated, sir, and I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly help you. To get started, could you please provide your order number?

It's VF88602. And don't give me the runaround. These things gave me massive blisters after one ride. I spent an hour trying to get the cleats right, and the fit is just terrible. I want a full refund, and I want it now, or I'm blasting VeloFit all over the internet.

I see. I'm pulling up your order now... VF88602. I see the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered 15 days ago. I'm very sorry to hear they caused blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers.
Yeah, well, it's the experience I got. So, are you going to process this refund or do I need to ask for your manager again?

There's no need for that, sir. I've just checked our policy. You are well within the 90-day return window for these shoes. I can absolutely process a full refund for you immediately. I'll email you a pre-paid return label right now.
Oh. It's... it's within 90 days? You're just going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. Our standard return policy covers you. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, your original payment method will be credited. You should see the refund in 3-5 business days after that. Is there anything else I can help with?
No. That's... that's all I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better day.
